launches.body:
**TL;DR:**

* ⏰ Veterinarians spend \~40% of their time on admin work, with note-taking alone making up \~20% of their time.
* 🎤 By recording patient meetings, Vetnio automatically generates clinical notes and emails in seconds.
* ✨ Additionally, Vetnio helps out with diagnostics, follow-ups, invoice generation, and more, reducing the risk of missed revenue for clinics while ensuring optimal care for animals.

[Introducing Vetnio](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6KIg5SJUUk)

# **Who are we and why are we doing this?**

We are [Arman](https://www.linkedin.com/in/armankaregar/) and [Max](https://www.linkedin.com/in/max-henry-xie/) from [Vetnio](https://vetnio.com). Being close friends for +10 years, Vetnio is the second startup we have co-founded together. We both have exceptional backgrounds within engineering, with Arman having 20 years of audio processing experience and Max being a self-taught developer since childhood.

It all started when Arman brought his 🐶, Knut  (picture below), to a stressful veterinary visit. He noticed how much time was spent by the veterinarian typing on a keyboard and immediately went on to think how this can be made better. After a quick discussion with Max, the idea for Vetnio was born.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcJzgeyF-gX-baUP0NVgep-EMa_iTLVKHwA9rQoA-Z6QiaTH4EpLeBazL_R_eKkrjHpWEyoNOZB-jKapY7RZ8S4hJesNc3OloZI59SRuyT8aI3ffpGw4lX3YGGRBEbn5k9hIoqThw?key=3XWI3B5KbKFPqOSqe7jrNCyD)

**Problem**\
With a rising patient load, veterinarians are overworked and stressed, leading to mistakes, burnout, and lost revenue. Admin work takes up \~40% of their time, and that's where Vetnio comes in.

**Solution**\
Vetnio has built an AI Copilot that records meetings and writes clinical notes, thereby saving veterinarians and clinics time, money, and headaches. Additionally, Vetnio helps out with diagnostics, follow-ups, invoice generation, and more, reducing the risk of missed revenue for clinics while ensuring optimal care for animals.

[Demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5PeoKr2yXSw)

**Case studies and traction**\
Among others, we work closely with the global leader in veterinary care, IVC Evidensia, and are currently conducting pilots with several prominent veterinary chains. Recently, the largest veterinary magazine in the Nordics published an independent interview with Evidensia, highlighting how our solution was saving them up to [15 minutes per 45-minute consultation](https://www.svenskveterinartidning.se/effektivare-journalforing-med-ai/), significantly reducing their administrative workload.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfl83aqSvXXbGlasaxpV0KXvgWps3LVxtVBnZiqCJviBcFmdyDyYwQbF6sug1O5t5dOBdLIJZ4jQvmLabMYOKqHTe00w-7iq77XJK00_KgfygNsDw5RCTP0Z6IwtdUB4wTfGfZX?key=3XWI3B5KbKFPqOSqe7jrNCyD)

📸: A veterinarian at Evidensia is reading through the text on Vetnio after a consultation.

She built up their Telemedicine department. Her expertise bridges veterinary care with innovative digital solutions.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvV6K2MqUVSNB2bVib11foOMVFvirQ8QB30POScCAmPVN4_2LroLO3krfFyZjNckQooyW37WXfKnw6KEWpUSCyStgxiPf1sA06FQOSJWcDwUMZX7jHbEbViw6NLQ_enJntrczWYA?key=3XWI3B5KbKFPqOSqe7jrNCyD)

### **Our ask**

We’re on a mission to make manual admin work a thing of the past.

👉 If you’d like to chat or know any veterinarians or practice owners who might find this helpful, don’t hesitate to reach out to us here: [founders@vetnio.com](mailto:founders@vetnio.com)
